_doc: Shared cases for gateway/response_filters.py (is_intentional_silence_response; optional 'strip' = strip_trailing_silence_marker, 'autonomous' = is_autonomous_silence_response) and its desktop twin apps/desktop/src/lib/silence-marker.ts (isSilenceMarkerText, stripTrailingSilenceMarker). Both suites load this file, so the server's delivery rule and the renderer's paint rule cannot drift apart.
